scaffold.User:
CREATE TABLE "users" ("user_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT) STRICT;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ux_users_email" ON "users" ("email");
scaffold.Counter: CREATE TABLE "counters" ("counter_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0) STRICT;
scaffold.Settings: CREATE TABLE "settings" ("user_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "nickname" TEXT, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT, "digest_hour" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 9, "locale" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))) STRICT;
scaffold.Comment: CREATE TABLE "comments" ("comment_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "parent_id" INTEGER, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY ("parent_id") REFERENCES "comments" ("comment_id") ON DELETE SET NULL) STRICT;
scaffold.Order:
CREATE TABLE "orders" ("order_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "tenant_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "customer_email" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtotal" TEXT NOT NULL, "tax" TEXT NOT NULL, "discount" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt" BLOB NOT NULL, "metadata" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT, "region" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL, "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shipping_days" INTEGER, "paid_at" TEXT, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1) STRICT;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ux_orders_external_id" ON "orders" ("external_id");

settings-upsert.sql: INSERT INTO "settings" ("user_id", "timezone", "nickname", "enabled", "note") VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT ("user_id") DO UPDATE SET "timezone" = excluded."timezone" RETURNING "user_id", "timezone", "nickname", "enabled", "note", "digest_hour", "locale", "created_at"
